biotools.summary: FEMA is a fast and efficient mixed-effects algorithm designed for analyzing large-scale neuroimaging data. It enables whole-brain vertex-wise, voxel-wise, and connectome-wide LME analyses, addressing limitations of traditional methods due to computational requirements.
